detail.longDescription: Why there is an error about broadcasting? ValueError Traceback (most recent call last) Cell In[7], line 3 1 import numpy as np 2 x = [] ----> 3 x += np.array([1, 2]) ValueError: operands could not be broadcast together with shapes (0,) (2,) The real puzzle is not that x += y raises an error by itself, but that it behaves differently from x = x.__iadd__(y) . According to the data model docs : [...] if x is an instance of a class with an __iadd__() method, x += y is equivalent to x = x.__iadd__(y) Since list.__iadd__ exists and does not return NotImplemented , why does x += y raise an error while x = x.__iadd__(y) does not? I expected x += y to append the elements of y to the list one by one rather than raise an error.
